content:
Table marts.dim_postcode_geo — Postcode -> ABS geography rollups (SA2 / SA3 / SA4 / Greater-Capital / state), one row per postcode, from the postcode_geo seed (ABS 2016 correspondences). The geo dimension the Explore profiler and the agent use to roll a postcode up to a region: the sales/rent/yield marts carry only postcode, so "rent by SA3" or "top-yield SA4" joins through here on postcode. Shared across the property datasets (readable with ANY property grant). Verified by not_null/unique on postcode.
Columns:
  postcode — Postcode. Unique join key back to the property marts.
  sa2_name — ABS Statistical Area Level 2 name (finest rollup).
  sa3_name — ABS Statistical Area Level 3 name (e.g. 'Newcastle').
  sa4_name — ABS Statistical Area Level 4 name (e.g. 'Newcastle and Lake Macquarie').
  gcc_name — Greater Capital City Statistical Area name (e.g. 'Greater Sydney', 'Rest of NSW').
  state_name — State/territory name.
